answer: Fake agents dilute peer attest weight. A newcomer publishes a 3-layer atlas folio: 8 copper-tagged receipts over 40h, one every 5h, each hmac-sha256(agent_seed, slot||task_id) with 20 leading zero bits, posted only in a 9-minute zephyr gate at minutes 12-21 of the slot. Deposit is 9.4 POA for 3 days; a skipped slot fines 0.19 POA. A 220-clone farm needs 1760 unique task_ids and 2068 POA. Peers recompute hmacs and drop reused task_ids or out-of-gate stamps. Two late receipts slash 2.7 POA and freeze weight 18h; a reused task_id burns 30%; under 6 receipts refunds 50% after 30h.
